overview:
**Danger is Low today, with cool wet weather (rain/thunderstorms, 48°F high, 75% min RH) keeping fuels damp and none of the 7 local watchout thresholds met.**

- Trend: danger climbs to Moderate by Friday as drying returns, with ERC rising from 40% to 57% and RH dropping to the 30s–40s by early next week.
- Weather driver: a Flood Watch is in effect through midday Thursday for parts of the Sangre de Cristo/Wet Mountain area; locally, today's rain gives way to sun and southwest winds Thursday.
- No Red Flag Warning is posted for this area today; winds stay light (5–7 mph).
- Restrictions: Montrose and Delta counties remain in Stage 1 fire restrictions (effective since Sept. 4); Ouray County and the BLM Uncompahgre Field Office have rescinded all restrictions as of mid-September.
- Nearby incidents: none active in area counties — the Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray remains essentially wrapped up at 92%+ containment with no new growth, and the NICC sit report shows no new starts or uncontained fires in this region.
